records.title: Flight operations from Halwara airport
details: a to d: However, M/s Air India has proposed to operate 14 flights per week to/ from Halwara Airport in the Summer Schedule 2026.

records.title: Railway infrastructure projects in Fatehgarh sahib Lok Sabha Constituency
details: Rajpura – Mohali new line project (18 Km) passing through Fatehgarh Sahib Constituency has been sanctioned recently at a cost of ₹ 443 crore. The project has been declared as special Railway Project. Competent Authority for land Acquisition (CALA) has been nominated in November 2025 and land acquisition has been taken up. This project will directly connect Southern Punjab (Bathinda area), between Sirhind – Gobindgarh and Rajpura area to Chandigarh avoiding Ambala.

records.title: R&D in Coal Technologies
details: Part b: (i) A "National Centre for Coal & Energy Sector" (NaCCER) has been planned to be established at CMPDI, Ranchi.

records.title: Data Breach BSNL
details: Further, an Inter Ministerial Committee (IMC) has been constituted to conduct audit of the telecom networks and suggest remedial measures for prevention of data breaches in the Telecom networks.
